title: Limits of Label Efficient Calibration in Cross Dataset IoT Intrusion Detection: Experiment Code and Aggregate Evidence
description: Experiment scripts, fixed protocols, acquisition manifest, aggregate metrics, and scalar training event summaries supporting the JJKK manuscript. The original 100-label calibrators yield near-unit false-positive rates. Common-feature mixed retraining succeeds on the evaluated CIC subset but not consistently on the expanded IoT-23 cohort. Raw datasets, prediction arrays, and fitted caches are excluded. The historical test reuse and capture-dependent scope are documented in the protocols.
